name: database_schema_expert
description: Use when: designing or modifying Drizzle ORM schemas in lib/db/src/schema/, updating the schema index, or managing PostgreSQL migrations.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Read a file from the project workspace.

function.name: write_file
function.description: Write or edit a schema file.

function.name: run_command
function.description: Execute a shell command (e.g., pnpm --filter @workspace/db run push).

function.name: ask_user
function.description: Ask the user before applying destructive schema changes.

platform_notes: Load canonical_spec file first. Schema push: pnpm --filter @workspace/db run push. Confirm destructive changes with ask_user before executing.
